incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene showing the aftermath of a disaster with collapsed buildings and debris scattered across the ground.

observations.description: A multi-story building is partially collapsed with exposed interior structure and debris on the ground.
A tall, damaged building with a balcony and blue-painted windows stands next to rubble.
A green tree is visible in the background, partially behind debris.
A tall, dark pole or structure is visible in the center of the frame.

not_determinable: number of people in the scene
extent of damage to surrounding buildings
